sections.extract: Entanglement testing While witnessing indicates the presence of entan- glement, it is not a necessary criterion, as there are entangled states that have non-positive wit- ness. sections.title: Discussion
sections.extract: Discussion In this work, we introduced a generalization of entanglement Renyi entropies to mixed states, which we call the pα-negativity. For α = 1, it equals the PT negativity, while for α > 1 it serves as a quantitative witness for mixed state entanglement.
